data.name: 21: Dead Man's Deck
data.detailed_description:
Find a rival. Put something on the felt.

21: Dead Man's Deck is online gothic blackjack. You find a living opponent on Steam, you wager coins or cards, and you draw toward twenty-one while a device on your chest counts the rounds you lose.

Pride tables cost nothing but the win. A coin purse is optional — the House holds both stakes until the match ends, and the winner leaves with twice what they put down. Blood Stakes are different: the winner takes two cards out of the loser's collection and keeps them.

Blackjack with a knife in it

  • Hit and stand toward a target of 21 — but the right card can move the target itself.

  • Everyone keeps a hole card. You can read their total, or you can read their hands. Only one of those is honest.

  • Going bust is not the end of it. Burn a trump to claw back under, or stand and take the bite.

Seven cards you choose to carry

Build a seven-card trump deck out of wards, curses, thefts and last resorts — cards that change a number, a rule, or somebody's mind.

  • Playing a trump does not end your turn. It buys you the next one.

  • Trumps run on charges, and charges come from winning rounds. Spend early and you'll be empty when it matters.

  • Open packs, strip the fallen for parts, and cut the deck down to the seven you'd actually stake your hand on.

Your body is the wager

Coins are not what's on the table. The machine is.

  • Every round you lose winds your device on one stage.

  • Four rounds and it finishes its work. So does the match.

  • Break theirs first and their seat at the House falls open to you.

Six tables teach the felt

Six players sat down against the Dealer before you did. They lost, and they stayed. Now they wear the House's masks and hold its tables — and none of them can show you their face, which makes them very hard to read.

  • The Gilded Smile — brass, fixed in a courtesy it cannot drop

  • The Porcelain Saint — white, mended along one seam, and no mouth at all

  • The Cinder Crown — riveted iron, a furnace grille still glowing

  • The Sheaf — blackened wheat bound with bone wire

  • The Ninth Hour — a bronze bell cast as a clock with no hands

  • The Green Lamp — signal glass, one lens green, one red

Beat all six and the Mirror of Judgement appears in the courtyard. It only ever leads one place.

How you sit

  • Online — find a rival through Steam. Pride, optional coin purses, or Blood Stakes. Escrowed by the House. Invite a friend if the parlor is quiet. In-game coins only, no cash-out. A House table, not a ranked ladder.

  • Blood Stakes — the winner takes two cards out of the loser's collection and keeps them.

  • Versus — pass the machine across the table. Only the player sitting sees their own hole card.

  • The Gauntlet — one run, rising rivals, and damage that carries between them. It ends when you do.

  • House tables — six Kept, then the Fate Dealer. An on-ramp, not the whole game.

Between hands

The courtyard is yours to walk. Buy a pack from the fortune-teller and watch the claw fetch it. Strip duplicates at the salvage box. Read the Rogues' Gallery on whoever is beating you. Search the crates — two or three are worth opening on any given day, and the House leaves notes.

Every candle in this place was lit for somebody.

Reach twenty-one. Don't go past it.

Interface and subtitles in English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil) and Japanese.

English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Spanish - Latin America*

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU required. Internet required for online matchmaking, cloud progress, and leaderboards. Keyboard and mouse or gamepad. Steam Deck supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Stable broadband recommended for online duels.
